node.title: XR four-anchor rank-two trades form a quadric centroid atlas
node.statement: Relative to the canonical four anchor columns of a coefficient-rank-four uniform rank-two trade, every non-anchor has support-three/four coordinates on one explicit smooth split quadric Q_B=sum_(i<j)(gamma_j-gamma_i)(c_i d_j-d_i c_j) beta_i beta_j. These coordinates give its four/five-block fundamental owner, and their exact affine centroid is (-1,-1,-1,-1). Conversely the quadric, centroid, finite-slope, and distinct-projection conditions give the complete coefficient-level q=4 atlas. Realized support embeddings, first-core selection, and aggregate payment remain open.
